questions.title: This questionnaire asks about your experience and opinion using the “Multistep” or “25 Steps” function on the Becton Dickinson (BD)’s infusion pumps. [Select one answer]
questions.text: Q0: This questionnaire asks about your experience and opinion using the “Multistep” or “25 Steps” function on the Becton Dickinson (BD)’s infusion pumps. [Select one answer] Definition: A “multistep” / “25 steps” infusion on a smart pump allows the clinician to program stepwise increases in infusion rate after a set time of delivery. For example, an infusion may be programmed to run at 5 ml/hr for 15 minutes, and then automatically increase its rate to 10 ml/hr for the next 15 minutes, to 20 ml/hr for the next 30 minutes, and then to reach its final stable rate of 30 ml/hr for the rest of the infusion. The operating interface examples: I understand and continue. I have not used this function – Thank and close

PICOTs for Research
PICOT 1:
BD nexus or BD Bodyguard (including CME pumps, which are the older generation of BD Bodyguard) users who have experience delivering multi step infusion modes requiring 15-minute titrations when administering specialist oncology infusions or intravenous immunoglobulin IVIG.
PICOT 2:BD neXus or BD Bodyguard (including CME pumps, which are the older generation of BD Bodyguard) users who have experience delivering ramp up or ramp down infusion profiles when administering Total Parenteral Nutrition TPN infusions.
PICOT 3:
BD neXus, BD Alaris neXus, and CareFusion Alaris Guardrails Plus Pumps users who have experience administering sepsis resuscitation fluids using a preset drug library entry with a default rate of 30mL/kg/hr, and administering noradrenaline using standardised doses or custom concentrations with default dosing in mcg/kg/min.
PICOT 4:
BD Alaris neXus (ACE/Wi Fi) and BD neXus (Connected Solution) users who have experience working with infusion pumps connected across the hospital network and creating or using an extensive DERS drug library, with active drug library management and supporting medication safety activities.
Questionnaire for PICOT 1 - “Multistep” or “25 Steps” function.
Q0: This questionnaire asks about your experience and opinion using the “Multistep” or “25 Steps” function on the Becton Dickinson (BD)’s infusion pumps. [Select one answer]
Definition:
A “multistep” / “25 steps” infusion on a smart pump allows the clinician to program stepwise increases in infusion rate after a set time of delivery. For example, an infusion may be programmed to run at 5 ml/hr for 15 minutes, and then automatically increase its rate to 10 ml/hr for the next 15 minutes, to 20 ml/hr for the next 30 minutes, and then to reach its final stable rate of 30 ml/hr for the rest of the infusion.
